OpenPrinting/cups-snap#41.desc: Fixed truncation of long system queue names by replacing a fixed 32-byte buffer with HTTP_MAX_URI in cups-proxyd (C)

OpenPrinting/cups-snap#43.desc: Removed echoed temporary queues from the system's CUPS, so cups-proxyd no longer leaves orphaned loopback queues on the host (C, fixes #39)

OpenPrinting/legacy-drivers#30.desc: Preserved the Mitsubishi CP50 Ghostscript driver from Ghostscript 9.22, with provenance, license notes and tested build instructions (fixes #26)

ArduPilot/ardupilot#34927.desc: Reject invalid SBUS data frames so they are not accepted as RC input (C++)

fossi-foundation/fossi-foundation-web#33.desc: Clarified local preview instructions in the website README (fixes #223)

OpenPrinting/cups-snap#44.desc: Made the CI sandbox test print the [Job ...] lines of error_log, so the real cause of filter failures shows up (requested by the maintainer in #43)

OpenPrinting/cpdb-libs#107.desc: Fixed a double free of service_name in cpdbResurrectPrinterFromFile(), found and verified with Valgrind (C)

OpenPrinting/legacy-drivers#31.desc: Preserved the IBM Omni driver from Ghostscript 9.20, with provenance, license notes and build test results on 9.19 and 9.20 (fixes #27)

OpenPrinting/legacy-drivers#33.desc: Preserved the dmprt dot matrix printer driver from Ghostscript 9.52, with provenance, license notes and build test results (fixes #25)

OpenPrinting/legacy-drivers#34.desc: Preserved four drivers found in foomatic-db (lbp660, c2070, ml85p, lpstyl), recovered from the Wayback Machine, with provenance, license notes and build test results

OpenPrinting/cpdb-libs#108.desc: Jobs printed with cpdbPrintFile() showed up as "untitled document"; now the file name is used as the job title (C)

OpenPrinting/cpdb-libs#109.desc: Fixed the cppcheck CI failure (nullPointerOutOfMemory) that broke every new PR, by checking the malloc() result in cpdbUnpackStringArray() (C)

OpenPrinting/cpdb-libs#110.desc: Fixed printer pickles working only once: reproduced the bug, traced it to the backend's replace handling, and made cpdbResurrectPrinterFromFile() re-register with the backend, so pickles survive backend restarts (C, fixes #94)
